title: Juice N Power Spark Watermelon Mojito Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Wake your senses with sweet, fresh watermelon and zesty lime, all touched with a hint of cool mint. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
